decision: Wave 0 test evidence can be produced with existing vendored Yarn/Node command families, Graphify structural verifiers, the test-receipt schema, and independent review ownership. Wave 0-specific fixtures are explicitly implementation-bound.
softRisks: CAP-002 through CAP-006 fixtures do not exist yet and are implementation-bound.
The exact CAP-001 structural verifier command may be task-specific.
Tests require the Node 22.23.1 and Yarn install state established in MR-INV-006.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Every Wave 0 test ID maps to an executable repository-discovered command and owner.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: 13 Wave 0 tests map to Wave 0 task owners and command families from TEST_COMMAND_REGISTRY and task command fields.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Required fixtures and offline/cross-platform conditions are available or explicitly implementation-bound.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: CAP-001 uses repository source; Wave 0 task fixtures are named and implementation-bound; all 13 tests are offline/cross-platform.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Receipt format and independent review responsibility are unambiguous.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: test-receipt.schema.json defines receipt fields; Wave 0 tasks require an independent reviewer who differs from the implementer.

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: No release-gate prerequisite is impossible before Wave 0 completion.
acceptanceCriteria.evidence: FINAL_WAVE_GATE_TEST_SYNCHRONIZATION_REPORT.json status=PASS, blockingDefects=[], Wave 0 gate audit MATCH.

testCommandMapping.command: python Graphify/11 Completion/validate_final_graphify_freeze.py --mode FINAL_FREEZE_CERTIFICATION --verify-only (repository-local structural verifier family)

keyRepositoryFacts.fact: GATE-WAVE_0 requires 13 test IDs and VERIFY_WAVE_0_RECEIPT.
TEST_COMMAND_REGISTRY maps available Yarn/Electron command families.
Wave 0 task reviewers require an independent reviewer different from the implementer.
